attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: causal_exp(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V, then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain; score functions: every weight exp(s_ti) is softplus(s_ti) exp(s_ti) (a forget gate's log decay stays in the exponent), s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k); f(s_ti) = softplus(s_ti) = log(1 + exp(s_ti)), evaluated as max(s_ti, 0) + log1p(exp(-|s_ti|))
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <RoPE(g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps)), RoPE(g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps))> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero
